newsitem.title: UK: London Insurance Janson offer recommended.
newsitem.headline: London Insurance Janson offer recommended.

text.p: London Insurance Market Investment Trust Plc said on Wednesday the board of Janson Green Holdings is recommending its 18.6 million stg cash offer for Janson.
Irrevocable undertakings to accept the offer have been received from the directors of Janson Green and certain shareholders, representing a total of 38.9 percent of the company's share capital.

London Insurance Market on August 8 said it had reached an advanced stage in agreeing an offer to be made for Janson Green Holdings, the holding company of the Lloyd's managing agency, Janson Green Ltd.

The 18.6 million stg cash offer also carries a full alternative of 7.5 percent convertible bonds repayable in 2001 and convertible into shares of London Insurance at a conversion price of 128 pence per share.
London Insurance said it expects the transaction to be completed in October.
